description: This Java class, SubjectDnCredentials, is a helper class used for generating authentication IDs for X.509 certificates during device authentication. It creates credentials based on tenant ID and subject distinguished name (DN) in RFC 2253 format, extending an abstract credentials class.

classes.name: SubjectDnCredentials
classes.description: A helper class for generating device authentication credentials based on X.509 certificate subject DN.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates SubjectDnCredentials using tenant ID and subject DN string or X500Principal.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the constant indicating the type of credentials, i.e., X.509 certificate.
